snippet.title: Control the Entire Battlefield - Hell Of War: Combined Arms Gameplay Trailer (FPS/RTS Hybrid)
snippet.description:
Hell Of War is a tactical FPS/RTS hybrid where you command the battlefield as a drone operator and take control of any unit in real time.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3602640/Hell_Of_War_Combined_Arms/
